OUR STORY

Built on the journey.

A transportation story, with a considered new chapter.

2016 / THE BEGINNING

Dependability,
from day one.

Martinez Logistics LLC began in 2016 with a 26-foot box truck, providing pickups and deliveries for businesses. Reliability, careful handling and customer service shaped the company’s approach to transportation.

2025 / A NEW CHAPTER

The move
to chauffeur service.

In 2025, the company expanded into luxury black car and limousine transportation, bringing its operational experience to corporate clients, special events, airport transfers and executive travel.
